label: Connection
description: Connect your Lexware Office account. Create an API key in Lexware under Extensions → Public API (app.lexware.de/addons/public-api) and paste it here. The Public API needs the Lexware plan XL.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.hint: Checks the saved API key with Lexware and shows how the account is set up

fields.label: Create documents automatically
fields.description: While this is on, an invoice is created in Lexware when an order is paid, and a credit note when a payment is refunded. Orders in other currencies than EUR are skipped.

actions.label: Retry failed documents
actions.hint: Tries again to create every document listed under Needs attention

modal.title: Retry failed documents
modal.description: Tries again to create every invoice and credit note that is listed under Orders → Lexware documents → Needs attention, and finishes the ones that were interrupted. Use it after you corrected what stopped them, for example the API key. A document that exists in Lexware is never created twice.
